title: Parking Lot
summary: Multi-floor parking with spot sizes, tickets and hourly fees.
description: Design the software for a multi-floor parking lot. Vehicles enter through an entry gate, get a ticket for a spot that fits them, and pay an hourly fee when they leave through an exit gate. Staff need to see how many spots are free on each floor.

requirements.text: The lot has multiple floors, each with many parking spots.
Spots come in sizes for motorcycles, cars and trucks; a vehicle may only park in a spot that fits it.
A ticket is issued on entry, recording the vehicle, the spot and the entry time.
On exit, the fee is calculated per hour (rates may differ by spot size) and paid.
Show the number of available spots per floor and per spot size.
Reject entry when no suitable spot is free.

constraints: Several entry and exit gates operate at the same time.
No real payment gateway; model payment as an interface.
Focus on classes and behaviour, not on persistence or UI.

changeRequest.title: EV charging spots
changeRequest.text: Add electric-vehicle charging spots. EV owners pay for charging per kWh on top of the hourly parking fee.
